decisions: Authored repo-local AGENTS.md at the root carrying the harness overlay (docs/architecture spine, .rah sidecar, implementation-gate discipline) plus the Windows Git Bash invocation rule, which cleared the doctor agents_visibility warning.
Left the repository un-initialized for Git: harness setup does not require it and initializing was outside the requested setup scope.
errors_resolved: Running pytest with the package root as CWD created .rah/ and .pytest_cache/ inside the skill package, which broke the closed package-manifest contract and made 6 tests fail with 'refusing state-mutating dispatch' (unmanaged_extra: .rah). Quarantining both directories and rerunning from /tmp produced a clean full pass.
new_procedures: Always run the RAH package test suite from a directory outside the package (e.g. `cd /tmp && python -m pytest <pkg>/tests/<file>.py -p no:cacheprovider`); pytest artifacts written into the package root violate invariant I6 and cause false failures.

`verify --tier full` and the whole-suite pytest run exceed the 5-minute shell execution cap on this machine (test_fleet.py alone is ~193 s); split verification into smoke tier plus per-file pytest runs instead of retrying the single long command.
This environment's reliability hook blocks assembled/backgrounded RAH command strings; invoke rah.py as a single literal `bash -lc "python '<abs path>/automation/rah.py' ..."` command.
